files.sewing-machine.md:
Mechanical sewing machine, all metal, with accessories

Price: $170

A solid 1990s mechanical machine with metal parts inside. It was serviced in 2024 and sews a straight, even stitch through denim and cotton alike.

The foot pedal cord has been re-taped where it meets the plug. It works, and a new cord is an easy swap if you prefer.

Included are six bobbins, three presser feet and the manual.

Pickup from Hornsby. My mother would love it to go to someone who sews.
